runtime: Public Microsoft MCR Azure IoT Operations 1.6.0
method: Actual MQTT results and native stage diagnostics, collected in separate isolated runs. Six earlier passes retained; the two Filter-dependent examples rerun after updating their documented artifact to Filter1.1.0.
deploymentSubstitutions: Debug namespace default instead of azure-iot-operations
Dedicated single-instance validation profiles instead of the default profile
Isolated graph names and MQTT topic prefixes

cases.name: Export completed training matches
cases.scope: Forward completed matches; no live fitting claimed

cases.name: Bounded recommendation
cases.scope: Positive, negative and fractional limits; stale, future, wrong-version and old-sequence rejection

cases.name: Multiway message routing
cases.scope: Speed, temperature and remaining paths, including unknown kinds

cases.name: Batch noise reduction
cases.scope: Exact updated documented YAML, actual mean output and negative fixtures

cases.name: Approved-envelope model republishing
cases.scope: Exact updated documented YAML, flat approved model and rejected envelopes

additionalValidation.documentedNumpyFittingExample: Passed locally; separate from the eight runtime graph examples
additionalValidation.customGraphs: Separately qualified against published chart1.0.0-rc.2; see1.0.0-rc.2.json

knownFailureResolved: Filter1.0.0 module transfer produced PacketTooLarge with the broker's default packet limit. Filter1.1.0 was used in the corrected documentation and the two affected examples were rerun successfully.
limitations: Finite functional examples, not throughput, durability or equipment-safety certification
Results were collected across separate runs, not one cold simultaneous deployment
